  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 1:01 PM, Vice Chair Adams called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Dean, Gonzalez, Hill, Swanson, Garbutt, Adams

Commissioners Absent: Romo, Vuong

Also present: Jennifer Kumiyama, Citywide Accessibility Coordinator, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk
Specialist.

Chair Vuong and Commissioner Romo are excused from the meeting.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55527  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Citizens' Advisory Commission on
  Disabilities meeting of Thursday, October 10, 2024.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Swanson, seconded by Commissioner
  Gonzalez, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6  Dean, Gonzalez, Hill, Swanson, Garbutt, Adams
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 2  Romo, Vuong

2.  24-55528  Recommendation to approve and submit a letter to Mayor and City Council
  regarding the accessibility of Long Beach Transit bus stop locations at Willow
  Springs Park, and limited bus service to and from the Queen Mary and the
  Aquarium of the Pacific.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Hill, seconded by Commissioner

3.  24-55529  Recommendation to receive and file reports from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Swanson, seconded by Commissioner
  Dean, to approve recommendation, as amended, to dissolve the LB Homeless
  Shelter Tours 2024 Ad Hoc Committee, and create the Unhoused Persons
  with Disability Needs Ad Hoc Committee, with the following members:
  Commissioner Dean, Commissioner Romo, and Commissioner Swanson. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Dean, Gonzalez, Hill, Swanson, Garbutt, Adams

  Recused: 0  None

  Absent: 2  Romo, Vuong

  Jennifer Kumiyama, Citywide Accessibility Coordinator, City Manager Department,
  spoke.

  Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, spoke.

  A dialogue ensued between Jennifer Kumiyama, Citywide Accessibility Coordinator,
  City Manager Department, and Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist.
